title: P15.9-A1 R1: zero GET side effects, strict company reads, verified artifacts, truthful pagination/inbox
description: R1 fixes on PR #91 (BASE e24e334) for 4 audited findings on read-only cockpit projections. F1 GET side effects: new statusReadOnly on ObjectiveAutoPolicyService/ObjectiveAutoDriverService — same owner proof + canonical row/anchor validation but never calls expireIfDue; due rows report expiry_pending=true. Canonical expiry contract unchanged (evaluate/status still expire lazily). auto_driver readiness dropped from cockpit: claimable->evaluate->expireIfDue has no read-only path (documented limitation). F2 strict company read: businessCompany no longer trusts raw objectives.list() rows — each candidate re-read via objectives.get (canonical row + digest + anchor proof); forged/tampered rows fail the whole projection closed. F3 artifact provenance: each listed artifact re-proved via ArtifactAuthority.verifyArtifactForConsumption against execution_id + mission_id binding and retained CAS bytes; unverifiable artifacts dropped, counted in artifacts_dropped_unverified, never shown as verified. F4 pagination/inbox: latest_review + review_count computed on FULL canonical history (no 200-cap prefix); objectiveReviews returns {reviews,total,returned,truncated}; owner_action_required suppressed on terminal objectives in cockpit lifecycle and company latest_review; businessCompany reports objectives_total_owned + objectives_truncated truthfully. Terminal objectives whose observation re-validation fails (grants/WAL legitimately ended) render with observation_error instead of 409 — live objectives still fail closed. No CEO/Router/Executor/KPI/Telegram changes; no new permissions; no UI/A2. Tests: 17/17 incl. all required negatives (zero-write expired policy, forged objective fail-closed, tampered binding + corrupt CAS dropped, >200 reviews exact latest/count, >200 objectives truthful truncation, ACHIEVED no pending inbox, HTTP denial preserved). No merge/deploy.
